derivation.spec_heading: 1. Actions and macros — the recorded-automation model
derivation.reproducible: Re-running spec-derive-microtasks.py against an unchanged spec reproduces this contract with this same mt_id.

clause: Dialog-option enumeration (normative, closed, four members) - enumeration
spec_anchor_status: RESOLVED: derived from the assembled Master Spec module, not provisional

scope.summary: Dialog-option enumeration (normative, closed, four members).** `dialog_options` is exactly one of: | Value | Token | Meaning | |---|---|---| | 0 | `silent` | never show a dialog for this step, even in interactive playback | | 1 | `show_if_configured` | show the dialog only when the step's `with_dialog` flag is set | | 2 | `show_in_interactive_playback` | show the dialog in interactive playback, suppress it in batch | | 3 | `always_show` | always show the dialog, including inside a batch job | The shipped distribution across 1,543 recorded steps is 901 `silent`, 630 `show_in_interactive_playback`, 10 `always_show` and 2 `show_if_configured`; 119 of those steps additionally carry `with_dialog = true`. In a headless batch run under [STU-AUT-112], `always_show` is the ONLY value that can block; a batch job MUST refuse to start when any enabled step in its action carries `always_show`, and MUST name the step, rather than hanging on a dialog no one can answer.
scope.spec_text_is_authority: The clause text above is quoted from the Master Spec. Where this contract and the spec differ, the spec wins and this contract is regenerated.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The enumeration accepts the member `0` with the exact meaning the spec states: `silent` | never show a dialog for this step, even in interactive playback. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `1` with the exact meaning the spec states: `show_if_configured` | show the dialog only when the step's `with_dialog` flag is set. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `2` with the exact meaning the spec states: `show_in_interactive_playback` | show the dialog in interactive playback, suppress it in batch. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `3` with the exact meaning the spec states: `always_show` | always show the dialog, including inside a batch job. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
